original_source.title: Windows 11 - Soft Triomphe Category - Editorial image covers four product tiles on en-vn locale
steps_to_reproduce: 2. Navigate to the Soft Triomphe category product listing page (PLP).
3. Scroll through the product grid where the large editorial campaign image is placed.
original_source.expected_result: Product tiles and the editorial image render in separate grid cells without overlapping or obscuring product tiles.
original_source.actual_result: The editorial image in the Soft Triomphe category overlaps/covers four product tiles in the grid on en-vn.

attachments.description: Highlighted screenshot of editorial image covering four product tiles
Screen recording from homepage to Soft Triomphe category grid

review_outcome.ttl_reviewer_message: uTest status tooltip: Technically valid bug, but customer has no plan to fix it; avoid reporting similar issues for this product.
review_outcome.resolution_notes: Verified Approved (Won't Fix) in Cycle 562001 (documented in BUG_LESSONS.md #1 and MASTER_BUG_LIBRARY.md #5).

normalized_fields.defect_category: Luxury Editorial Grid Layout (Won't Fix Pattern)

agent_analysis.why_approved_high_value: Approved because 4 product tiles were obscured, but marked Won't Fix (WNF) because luxury fashion sites frequently use asymmetric editorial grid overlays and treat layout quirks as low-priority or intentional.

inferred_lessons: Approved (Won't Fix) is a warning signal: do not farm additional editorial grid/layout bugs on that product; pivot immediately to functional cart/filter/checkout mechanics.
